description: IComment gains optional read-only bundle_mirror_source { source_comment_id, master_ticket_id?, master_ticket_number? } | null
MSP getConsolidatedTicketData comments query left-joins ticket_bundle_mirrors → source comment → master ticket (tenant-co-located) and maps bundle_mirror_source with master id and number
Client portal getClientTicketDetails conversations query left-joins ticket_bundle_mirrors and maps bundle_mirror_source with source_comment_id only (no master identity selected)
Comments loaded without the join (undefined bundle_mirror_source) render as non-mirrors
resolveCommentAuthor returns source 'system' / avatarKind 'system' when no user/contact resolves and is_system_generated is true; 'unknown' otherwise
resolveCommentAuthor parameter type widened to include is_system_generated; ResolvedCommentAuthor source/avatarKind unions include 'system'
New SystemAvatar component in packages/ui renders a lucide glyph (Cog for 'system', Layers for 'bundle') with no initials, neutral tokens, role=img and aria-label
SystemAvatar reuses EntityAvatar getSizeStyle and the size→shape rule (xs square, sm+ circle); exported from packages/ui index
SystemAvatar root carries data-avatar-kind='system'|'bundle'
CommentItem renders SystemAvatar glyph='bundle' for a system-author comment that is a bundle mirror
CommentItem renders SystemAvatar glyph='system' for a system-author comment that is not a bundle mirror
CommentItem author name is 'Bundled update' for a system-author mirror and 'System' for a system-author non-mirror; email line hidden for both
CommentItem still renders the Unknown User placeholder avatar/name (or inbound sender initials) for unresolvable non-system comments
CommentItem renders the bundled-update chip whenever bundle_mirror_source is set, regardless of whether the author resolved
Chip text is 'Bundled update from {{number}}' when master_ticket_number is present, else 'Bundled update'
Chip is an anchor to /msp/tickets/{master_ticket_id} only when master_ticket_id is present; otherwise a plain span (portal)
bundleMaster prop removed from CommentItem, TicketConversation, BentoTimelineTile, TicketBentoLayout and TicketDetails; master comes from the comment row
Resolvable-author mirrors keep #3439 behaviour: real avatar, author name, chip
Bento timeline reply-target name uses the resolver's 'System' display name for system-author comments
Locale key conversation.systemAuthor added to de, en, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt; xx/yy regenerated
Locale key conversation.bundledUpdateFrom ('Bundled update from {{number}}') added to de, en, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt; xx/yy regenerated
updateComment/deleteComment inputs do not accept bundle_mirror_source (view-only field never persisted)
Worktree merged with origin/main so mirrorCommentToChild / apply_resolution path is present before implementation
